coverage.evidence: Every documented key exists (StreamLiveHelpers.cs:24-107; StreamGameHelpers.cs:21; StreamStatsHelpers.cs:23-83; StreamLastHelpers.cs:24-68; StreamHistoryHelpers.cs:25-53; LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:441-463). Rows require an exact argument count (StreamHelperRow.cs:50-152). title.short takes 1..140 (StreamLiveHelpers.cs:81, TitleMax=140 via TryPositive). games.history and topChatters take 1..25 (StreamHistoryHelpers.cs:25, GamesMax=25; StreamStatsHelpers.cs:83, TopMax=25).

Formats match StreamText.cs: Grouped uses N0 with culture, Compact gives 1.2k and 3.4M, Words has precision 2, Short reads '4h 10m', Clock reads '2:15:00' and '15:00' under an hour, Hours are rounded to 2 places, the UTC zone is the fallback, LocalTime is HH:mm, Date is UTC yyyy-MM-dd, Cut ends with an ellipsis and keeps a title that fits, and Named reads 'Name (count)'. Boxart is 285x380 (StreamGameHelpers.cs:21). hours.month adds 'h' and number reads 'stream #' (StreamHistoryHelpers.cs:45,53).

title, game, uptime and isLive use ViewerInfoContexts, while viewers and startedAt use AllContexts (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40,209-214). stream.url and stream.thumbnail are DiscordOnly (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:784,787; DiscordChannelLinks.cs gives an empty thumbnail off Twitch). The extended rows use Standard (StreamHelperRow.cs:155).

The stats read the newest stream by StartedAt, with the window running to EndedAt or now (StreamHelperData.cs:61-74; StreamStatsService.cs:84-100). The last stream is the first ended stream of the recent 5, from a list ordered newest first (StreamHelperData.cs:81-97; ChannelAnalyticsService.cs:185). The monthly counts and history read the newest 100 streams in the channel time zone (StreamHelperData.cs:38,85-86; StreamHistoryHelpers.cs:25-53).

Offline, uptime gives 'offline', viewers '0', isLive 'false' and startedAt an empty text (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:441-463), because WentLiveAt is cleared when the stream goes offline (ChannelOfflineHandler.cs:154; StreamStatusPollingService.cs:395). The extended uptime and startedAt forms, id and viewers.compact are null offline (StreamHelperRow.cs:26-29; StreamLiveHelpers.cs:24-107). status gives 'offline' (StreamLiveHelpers.cs:68). hypetrains is null with no train (HypeTrainMetric; StreamStatsHelpers.cs:63-64).

Lists are capped at 5 and ranked by count, then name (StreamFactReader.cs:136-148). newList is the oldest five (NewFollowersMetric.cs:29,34), selfSubs is at most five (SelfSubsMetric.cs:36,41) and raids are ordered by viewers, at most five (RaidsInMetric.cs:33-34). subs are new non-gift, resub and gift (SubsMetric). Bits, gifters (the larger of batch and notice counts), chat, commandsRun, redemptions, songRequesters (count of song records) and peak (the larger of the stored peak and the samples) match their metric files (BitsMetric.cs, GiftersMetric.cs, ChatMetric.cs, CommandsRunMetric.cs, RedemptionsMetric.cs, SongRequestersMetric.cs, PeakViewersMetric.cs). Banned viewers are left out of chat, command, reward, song and fact counts (StreamBanFilter.cs; StreamFactReader.cs:97). The last-stream counts use no ban filter (StreamActivityCounts.cs; ChannelAnalyticsService.cs:200-223,249-264).

reader_answers.evidence: The tables match the time scopes (StreamHelperData.cs:61-97), and the argument ranges match StreamLiveHelpers.cs:81, StreamHistoryHelpers.cs:25 and StreamStatsHelpers.cs:83.

The contexts match TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40,209-214 and StreamHelperRow.cs:155. With no recorded stream the stats call fails and the helper renders as typed (StreamStatsService.cs:84-100; TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19,44).
A null result prints as typed (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19,44). The extended live forms are null offline (StreamHelperRow.cs:26-29), and the three scopes match StreamHelperData.cs:61-97.

{stream.game} reads the live channel (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:441-463). While live the stats describe the running stream and stream.last.* describes the newest ended one. After the stream ends, the stats still describe it until the next stream starts (StreamStatsService.cs:84-100; StreamHelperData.cs:89-97).
